title: Canonical map from the generation locus of a line module into relative Proj
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $f:X\to T$ a morphism over $S$. Let $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{d\geq0}\mathcal A_d$ be a quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal O_T$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra] [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], let $L$ be a line module on $X$, and let $\psi:f^*\mathcal A\to\bigoplus_{d\geq0}L^{\otimes d}$ be a graded algebra homomorphism on the small etale site, with tensor pullback $f^*$ along the induced ringed-topos map. Let $U(\psi)\subseteq X$ be the union over $d\geq1$ of the loci where $\psi_d:f^*\mathcal A_d\to L^{\otimes d}$ is surjective. This is an open subspace, and there is a canonical $T$-morphism $r_{L,\psi}:U(\psi)\to\operatorname{Proj}_T(\mathcal A)$ [def-nagata-relative-proj]. For any etale map of schemes $g:T'\to T$ for which $X'=X\times_TT'$ is a scheme, put $\mathcal A'=g^*\mathcal A$, let $L'$ be the restriction of $L$, and let $\psi'$ be the restricted homomorphism. Then $U(\psi')=X'\times_XU(\psi)$, and under the canonical isomorphism $\operatorname{Proj}_{T'}(\mathcal A')\simeq T'\times_T\operatorname{Proj}_T(\mathcal A)$ the map $r_{L',\psi'}$ is the base change of $r_{L,\psi}$. On schemes this is the usual canonical morphism obtained from the graded maps into tensor powers of an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], with pullback [def-pc-module-pullback].
